name: 编程防护
description: 编程安全插件：Tool 提供只读安全审查，Rail 独立控制真实工具调用。

display_description.en: Read-only security review plus an independent runtime execution guard.
display_description.zh: 以只读安全审查分析代码风险，并由独立运行时门禁控制危险操作。

default_init_input.zh: 审查这段代码、命令或文件的安全风险，并给出证据和整改建议。
default_init_input.en: Review this code, command, or file for security risks and provide evidence and remediation advice.

quick_inputs.zh: 审查这段代码、命令或文件的安全风险，并给出整改建议。
quick_inputs.en: Review this code, command, or file for security risks and remediation advice.

quick_inputs.zh: 检查工作区文件中的密钥、危险命令与不安全代码。
quick_inputs.en: Check this workspace file for secrets, dangerous commands, and unsafe code.

quick_inputs.zh: 审查这段脚本并给出更安全的替代写法。
quick_inputs.en: Review this script and suggest a safer alternative.

display_description.en: Read-only review of code, commands, or workspace files with findings and remediation advice.
display_description.zh: 只读审查代码、命令或工作区文件，返回风险发现与整改建议。

display_description.en: Runtime gate: deny skips the tool, require_approval asks the user, and warn proceeds with context.
display_description.zh: 运行时门禁：deny 跳过工具，require_approval 征求确认，warn 放行并回传原因。
